_doc: Reference rows `mise run triage` files as known: differences the repository already explains, so a triage lists only what is left to look at. `build` is a fragment of the build folder's name, `stats` the rows it explains, `reason` where the explanation is. Add an entry when a difference is documented as deliberate; remove it when the engine changes.

one Blind, the strongest of the character's skills (docs/maintainer-guide.md, Blind)
